# Icon

A drawn mark of the design; decorative, the control around it carries the meaning.

- Status: implemented
- Category: data
- Pattern: HTML `inline <svg aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">`

## Anatomy

- **glyph**: Paths in currentColor; size.icon by default.

## Variants

- `forward`: The arrow turned to the reading direction.
- `back`:
- `down`:
- `external`: Out of the site: the arrow up and forward, mirrored right to left.

## States

- `default`

## Accessibility

- Role: none (aria-hidden)
- An icon-only control has its own accessible name.

WCAG 2.2 success criteria:

- 1.1.1 Non-text Content (A)
- 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast (AA)

## Platforms

| Platform | Implementation |
| --- | --- |
| web | svg.nd-icon (packages/web/icons.json) |
| ios | NDVectorImage(icon) |
| android | Icon(NDIcon.x.imageVector) |
| flutter | NDVectorIcon.icon(icon) |

Web: `.nd-icon` in kit.css; modifiers `.nd-icon--forward`, `.nd-icon--back`, `.nd-icon--down`, `.nd-icon--external`.
